coverage_note: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD independent district comparison, 2024–25: all 78 audited enrolled grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles enter each separate Math, ELA and Combined model. Exact CCD LEA 4816110 / TX-101907 / TAPR 101907 crosswalks bind native campuses to NCES identities. The complete linked audit retains all 94 operational CCD schools and 92 native campuses, including 13 high schools, one primary-only campus and two alternative CCD campuses without any native REF, enrollment or assessment record. Those gaps stay missing, never zero or name-matched. Outcomes are original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above enrolled grades 3–8 Including EOC, with STAAR, Spanish and Alternate 2. Income uses precise October 25, 2024 individual economic-status counts divided by native enrollment, broader than uniform FRPL and tested pupils. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals unavailable modelwide. Admissions, provider roles, programs, coordinates and boundaries remain unaudited; one year only.

methodology.summary: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD independent original published-rate grade-school district models with precise same-year individual economic status; valid-score count scope and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Cypress-Fairbanks ISD independent 2024–25 published-rate grade-school district models use exact operational CCD LEA 4816110 / TX-101907 / TAPR district 101907 identities. All 78 native enrolled positive grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles remain searchable and enter each separate Math, ELA and Combined model using original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above rates and precise same-year individual economic-status enrollment ratios. Thirteen high schools, one primary campus and two operational alternative campuses without native records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Separate unweighted district OLS and externally studentized residuals retain all 78 eligible schools per subject and all 234 explicit deleted fits. Combined is the equal mean of original Math and ELA whole percentages with its own fit, deleted residual scale and studentization, not proficiency in both or averaged subject residuals. Filters never refit; statewide and other district fits are never reused. Associations do not establish causal school effectiveness or overall quality.

Reconstruct exact operational same-year CCD attachments, complete native enrolled EE/PK/K/1–12 counts with positive grades 3–8 and zero grades 9–12, reconciled individual economic status and each original unmasked whole-percent R cell. Preserve all 78 grade-school profiles and their 78 original unmasked Math/ELA/paired Combined members. Exact operational alternative campuses 101907006 and 101907014 remain unmatched to all native originals and are retained outside these fits, without name or zero substitution. Reported tests/numerators, charter/type/reference labels and diagnostics never select membership.

Only original published whole-percent CDA38AM0E225R / CDA38AR0E225R. Do not reconstruct masks, substitute count-ratio precision, reuse statewide or another district’s fits, or average grade percentages.

Individual October 25, 2024 PEIMS fall economic status uses each school’s own count of individually classified economically disadvantaged pupils divided by its own all-enrolled EE–12 count. State codes 01/02/99 include free or reduced-price meal eligibility or other public assistance. ED plus non-ED and the native tenth-percent display must reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy is not uniform FRPL or household income and does not exactly describe the tested pupils.

CEP requires individual direct certification and annual local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all children. Provision 2 may retain base-year eligibility for continuously enrolled students. Missing surveys may yield code 00; identification coverage and undercount are unknown. The January 16, 2025 resubmission extension requires enrollment and eligibility on October 25, 2024, without another-year backfill.

Original 2024–25 All Students TAPR rates cover enrolled grades 3–8 Math and ELA Including EOC at Meets Grade Level or Above. Native #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain unverified reported evidence. The accountability subset requires the same district and campus on the fall snapshot and testing date. STAAR with or without accommodations, Spanish STAAR, Alternate 2 and applicable Algebra I and English I–II EOC are included as documented. Separate TPRS all-testers, both-subject passing and participation measures are not used.

All 92 native campuses reconcile individual ED plus non-ED with native enrollment. Native enrollment and CCD school/LEA totals are 117,927; separate PEIMS membership totals 117,658 and differs at 72 campuses. These concepts remain distinct; differences do not prove a cause or furnish tested denominators.

All 78 Math and ELA published whole-percent rates differ from unverified reported-count ratios. Counts never supply more precise outcomes, certify score status, screen membership or complete missing cells. Operational alternative campuses 101907006/NCES 481611008601 and 101907014/NCES 481611012265 have no original native rows and remain outside the 78-profile comparison, with complete CCD evidence linked.

Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Native reported performance #Tests, enrollment, PEIMS/CCD membership, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute for valid-score denominators. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals unavailable. Studentization uses each deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom, without enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Exact 2025 N/NAAR and M/medical scope remains unresolved; this release does not certify a ten-valid-scored minimum.

Full and all deleted designs have rank two and finite positive residual scales. Every observed income endpoint and influential member remains included. Hairgrove has the highest Cook distance in each model and remains eligible. OLS predictions are not clamped; leverage, Cook distance and residual flags are descriptive only.

The complete immutable source audit retains all 1,107 original records, 42,828 typed cells, complete native headers and primary definitions. Compact evidence preserves exact original rows and fields plus the six historical audit/code/test pins. The full source and numerical evidence must remain available and unchanged on every replay and import. Historical approvals remain false; only this separately validated grade-school contract is released.

One year only; programs are Unclassified and admissions, provider roles, map coordinates and district boundaries remain unknown. Varying grade and assessment mixes, rounded displays, broader fall economic status and omitted prior attainment or admissions remain limitations. State thresholds and income proxies do not create a common national ranking.
